arxiv-2102-10147.title: Effects of Coulomb Coupling On Friction In Strongly Magnetized Plasmas
arxiv-2102-10147.creator: David J. Bernstein, Scott D. Baalrud
arxiv-2102-10147.description: Abstract The friction force on a test particle traveling through a plasma that is both strongly coupled and strongly magnetized is studied using molecular dynamics simulations. In addition to the usual stopping power component aligned antiparallel to the velocity, a transverse component that is perpendicular to both the velocity and Lorentz force is observed.

arxiv-2104-00139.title: Adversarial Heart Attack: Neural Networks Fooled to Segment Heart Symbols in Chest X-Ray Images
arxiv-2104-00139.creator: Gerda Bortsova, Florian Dubost, Laurens Hogeweg, Ioannis Katramados, Marleen de Bruijne
arxiv-2104-00139.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Gerda Bortsova, Florian Dubost, Laurens Hogeweg, Ioannis Katramados, Marleen de Bruijne. Adversarial attacks consist in maliciously changing the input data to mislead the predictions of automated decision systems and are potentially a serious threat for automated medical image analysis. Previous studies have shown that it is possible to adversarially manipulate automated segmentations produced by neural networks in a targeted manner in the white-box attack setting (assuming the full access to the target model).

arxiv-2209-09444.title: Vega-MT : The JD Explore Academy Translation System for WMT22
arxiv-2209-09444.creator: Changtong Zan, Keqin Peng, Liang Ding, Baopu Qiu, Boan Liu, Shwai He, Qingyu Lu, Zheng Zhang, Chuang Liu, Weifeng Liu, Yibing Zhan, Dacheng Tao

arxiv-2311-00830.title: User Experiences with Third-Party SIM Cards and ID Registration in Kenya and Tanzania Woodstock ’18: ACM Symposium on Neural Gaze Detection, June 03–05, 2018, Woodstock, NY Price: 15.00 ISBN: 978-1-4503-XXXX-X/18/06 CCS: Human-centered computing User studies CCS: Security and privacy Social aspects
arxiv-2311-00830.creator: Edith Luhanga, Karen Sowon, Lorrie Faith Cranor, Giulia Fanti, Conrad Tucker, Assane Gueye
arxiv-2311-00830.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Edith Luhanga, Karen Sowon, Lorrie Faith Cranor, Giulia Fanti, Conrad Tucker, Assane Gueye. Mobile money services in Sub-Saharan Africa (SSA) have increased access to financial services. To ensure proper identification of users, countries have put in place “Know-Your-Customer” (KYC) measures such as SIM registration using an official identification. However, half of the 850 million people without IDs globally live in SSA, and the use of SIM cards registered in another person’s name (third-party SIM) is prevalent.

arxiv-2311-14268.title: Synthetic FM triplet for AM-free precision laser stabilization and spectroscopy Journal: optica Publication type: Research article
arxiv-2311-14268.creator: Dhruv Kedar, 1,2,* Zhibin Yao, 1,2 Ivan Ryger, 1 John L. Hall, 1 and Jun Ye 1
arxiv-2311-14268.description: Abstract The Pound-Drever-Hall (PDH) cavity-locking scheme has found prevalent uses in precision optical interferometry and laser frequency stabilization. A form of frequency modulation spectroscopy, PDH enjoys superior signal-to-noise recovery, large acquisition dynamic range, wide servo bandwidth, and robust rejection of spurious effects.

arxiv-2402-04918.title: Prompting Implicit Discourse Relation Annotation
arxiv-2402-04918.creator: Frances Yung Mansoor Ahmad Merel Scholman Vera Demberg
arxiv-2402-04918.description: Abstract Pre-trained large language models, such as ChatGPT, archive outstanding performance in various reasoning tasks without supervised training and were found to have outperformed crowdsourcing workers. Nonetheless, ChatGPT’s performance in the task of implicit discourse relation classification, prompted by a standard multiple-choice question, is still far from satisfactory and considerably inferior to state-of-the-art supervised approaches.

arxiv-2405-11713.title: Decentralized Privacy Preservation for Critical Connections in Graphs Thanks: C. Li, W. Ni, M. Ding, Y. Qu, D. Smith, T. Rakotoarivelo are with the Data 61, Commonwealth Scientific and Industrial Research Organisation (CSIRO), Sydney, NSW 2016. E-mail: {conggai.li, wei.ni, ming.ding, youyang.qu, dav
arxiv-2405-11713.creator: Conggai Li, Wei Ni, Ming Ding, Youyang Qu
arxiv-2405-11713.description: Abstract Many real-world interconnections among entities can be characterized as graphs. Collecting local graph information with balanced privacy and data utility has garnered notable interest recently. This paper delves into the problem of identifying and protecting critical information of entity connections for individual participants in a graph based on cohesive subgraph searches.

arxiv-2409-03246.title: A priori and a posteriori error bounds for the fully mixed FEM formulation of poroelasticity with stress-dependent permeability
arxiv-2409-03246.creator: Arbaz Khan \ORCID 0000-0001-6625-700X, Bishnu P. Lamichhane \ORCID 0000-0002-9184-8941, Ricardo Ruiz-Baier* \ORCID 0000-0003-3144-5822 and Segundo Villa-Fuentes \ORCID 0000-0002-0377-6555
arxiv-2409-03246.description: Abstract We develop a family of mixed finite element methods for a model of nonlinear poroelasticity where, thanks to a rewriting of the constitutive equations, the permeability depends on the total poroelastic stress and on the fluid pressure and therefore we can use the Hellinger–Reissner principle with weakly imposed stress symmetry for Biot’s equations.

arxiv-2410-04528.title: Round Trip Time Estimation Utilizing Cyclic Shift of Uplink Reference Signal
arxiv-2410-04528.creator: Rajeev Gangula 1 , Tommaso Melodia 1 , Rakesh Mundlamuri 1 2 , and Florian Kaltenberger 1 2, 2 Communication Systems Department, EURECOM, Biot, France, 1 Institute for the Wireless Internet of Things, Northeastern University, Boston, USA
arxiv-2410-04528.description: Abstract In the context of fifth-generation new radio (5G NR) technology, it is not possible to directly obtain an absolute uplink (UL) channel impulse response (CIR) at the base station (gNB) from a user equipment (UE). The UL CIR obtained through the sounding reference signal (SRS) is always time-shifted by the timing advance (TA) applied at the UE.

arxiv-2509-04361.creator: S. Abubakar, M. A. Acero, B. Acharya, P. Adamson, N. Anfimov, A. Antoshkin, E. Arrieta-Diaz, L. Asquith, A. Aurisano, D. Azevedo, A. Back, N. Balashov, P. Baldi, B. A. arxiv-2509-04361.description: Abstract This Letter reports measurements of muon-neutrino disappearance and electron-neutrino appearance and the corresponding antineutrino processes between the two NOvA detectors in the NuMI neutrino beam. These measurements use a dataset with double the neutrino mode beam exposure that was previously analyzed, along with improved simulation and analysis techniques.

arxiv-2512-08637.title: A Persistent Homology Pipeline for the Analysis of Neural Spike Train Data
arxiv-2512-08637.creator: Cagatay Ayhan, Audrey N. Nash, Roberto Vincis, Martin Bauer, Richard Bertram, Tom Needham
arxiv-2512-08637.description: Abstract In this article, we introduce a Topological Data Analysis (TDA) pipeline for neural spike train data. Our framework treats a collection of spike trains recorded from a population of neurons as a metric space, endowed with the Victor-Purpura (VP) distance, to which techniques of persistent homology are applied.

arxiv-2512-23861.title: Stochastic multi-step cell size homeostasis model for cycling human cells
arxiv-2512-23861.creator: Sayeh Rezaee, Cesar Nieto, Abhyudai Singh
arxiv-2512-23861.description: Abstract Measurements of cell size dynamics have established the adder principle as a robust mechanism of cell size homeostasis. In this framework, cells add a nearly constant amount of size during each cell cycle, independent of their size at birth. Theoretical studies have shown that the adder principle can be achieved when cell-cycle progression is coupled to cell size.
